niphal.sense_hint: simple (this root has no attested qal; niphal serves as its basic/citation stem)

notes: All three attestations (Hos.4.14, Prov.10.8, Prov.10.10) are the identical form יִלָּבֵט; Hos.4.14 kept as citation per the usual duplicate-slot tie-break, the other two are textually identical repeats, not independent evidence of a different form.

Gloss overlap (stem-level, not a search-index collision): "be ruined" also appears as a niphal/pual stem_gloss on the existing חבל (H2254) and שחת (H7843), whose own root-level glosses are different ("take/hold in pledge; spoil" and "ruin") -- no alias needed since neither of their search indexes carries "be ruined".
